status: source-only; not device compiled or GPU qualified

exports.name: infinity_splade_pool_bf16_f32
exports.purpose: SPLADE vocabulary max over selected tokens then BF16 log1p then F32 widening

exports.name: infinity_attention_row_gather_bf16
exports.purpose: ColBERT K/V row gather for MASK-excluded attention keys

exports.name: infinity_colbert_l2_bf16_f32
exports.purpose: ColBERT model-dtype BF16 norm/clamp/division, widened to F32 result rows

host_contract.device_pointers: CUDA addresses in the backend's bound context; retained through ordered-stream completion
host_contract.row_stride: source_stride >= width; K/V packed row stride is 3*hidden for BERT QKV
host_contract.attention: ColBERT passes q_offsets=original token boundaries, k_offsets=selected key boundaries, k_tokens=selected keys; MASK rows remain query rows
host_contract.l2: projection is BF16; F32 norm accumulation followed by BF16 norm output, BF16 epsilon clamp, BF16 quotient and F32 widening; exact ATen reduction remains GPU gated
host_contract.fa4_boundary_contract: ColBERT reuses the existing additive AttentionBatch contract with separate INT32 q_offsets (original query token boundaries) and k_offsets (selected key boundaries). No padded query/key lengths are synthesized. The shared fa4 check_batch/separate_qk_forbidden guard returns a typed rejection for providers/geometries that require shared lengths; the documented BERT d32/d64 geometries do not hit that guard.
